2014_spells.spare-the-dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
2014_spells.spare-the-dying.effectSummar: touch a living creature that has 0 hit points
2014_spells.spare-the-dying.fullDescript: Using 1 action, you touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs; The creature becomes stable. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
